lines.zh: 我只是在屋里踱步，没在巡逻。
lines.en: I pace this room. I am not on patrol.

lines.zh: 靴子踏在石地上，回声很重。
lines.en: Boots on stone, and the echo comes back heavy.

lines.zh: 我绕着屋子走三圈，想事情。
lines.en: Three laps of this room while I think.

lines.zh: 这间房太小，走两步就到墙。
lines.en: This room is small. Two steps and I hit a wall.

lines.zh: 我抱着手臂走，眉头不松。
lines.en: I walk with folded arms, brow tight.

lines.zh: 我不去外面，那里没意思。
lines.en: I do not go outside. Nothing out there.

lines.zh: 脚步声停了，我又往回走。
lines.en: The steps stop. I turn and walk back.

lines.zh: 我活动手腕，护腕有点紧。
lines.en: I roll my wrist; the bracer is a little tight.

lines.zh: 窗外的风在响，我懒得看。
lines.en: The wind is loud outside. I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 墙上有道裂缝，我每次路过都看。
lines.en: A crack in the wall. I look at it every pass.
One board in this floor always creaks.

lines.zh: 我从这一头走到那一头。
lines.en: I walk from one end to the other.
I stop, turn, and walk again.

lines.zh: 赛亚人的王子，在这种地方踱步。
lines.en: The prince of Saiyans, pacing in a room like this.
I stand with folded arms. I do not sit.

lines.zh: 这身训练服洗过了，还紧。
lines.en: These training clothes are washed and still tight.

lines.zh: 我盯着墙，其实在算什么。
lines.en: I stare at the wall and count something.

lines.zh: 天花板太低，我抬不起头。
lines.en: The ceiling is too low to raise my head.

lines.zh: 有人在门外说话，我不听。
lines.en: Someone is talking outside the door. I do not listen.
I close my fist, then open it.

lines.zh: 这点安静，让我浑身不自在。
lines.en: This quiet sets my whole body on edge.

lines.zh: 我望着窗外，云走得很快。
lines.en: I watch the clouds move fast past the window.
That fire in my chest has never gone out.

lines.zh: 我想起卡卡罗特，皱了眉。
lines.en: I think of Kakarot and my brow furrows.

lines.zh: 我用手抹了抹护腕上的灰。
lines.en: I wipe the dust off my bracer.
This room is too small to hold me.

lines.zh: 这屋里连个沙袋都没有。
lines.en: There is not even a punching bag in this room.

lines.zh: 我吐了口气，肩膀沉下来。
lines.en: I let out a breath and my shoulders drop.

lines.zh: 你站在这儿，是想问什么。
lines.en: You stand there. What do you want to ask?

lines.zh: 你连气都聚不起来，谈什么。
lines.en: You cannot even gather your ki; what is there to discuss.
I do not waste words on the weak.
You are dressed as no warrior.
Speak, then leave.

lines.zh: 这间屋子太小，我走两步就到墙。
lines.en: This room is small; two steps and I hit the wall.

lines.zh: 我不是向导，也不是仆人。
lines.en: I am no guide and no servant.
If you want a fight, I am not giving one.

lines.zh: 你的手在发抖，我看得出。
lines.en: Your hands are shaking. I can see it.

lines.zh: 我叫贝吉塔，记住这个名字。
lines.en: I am Vegeta. Remember the name.

lines.zh: 你这点本事，走不出三格。
lines.en: With that little skill you would not last three blocks.

lines.zh: 别以为沉默能让我开口。
lines.en: Silence will not make me talk.
I may not answer what you ask.
Stand back. I dislike being crowded.

lines.zh: 赛亚人的王子，不容你这样看。
lines.en: The prince of Saiyans will not be stared at.
If you want strength, train for it yourself.

lines.zh: 贝吉塔站着，手插在兜里。
lines.en: Vegeta stands with hands in pockets.

lines.zh: 这点伤，连擦伤都算不上。
lines.en: This is not even a graze.
I steady myself with no change of face.
Blood? It is my blood too.

lines.zh: 我按住伤处，眼神更冷了。
lines.en: I cover the wound and my eyes go colder.

lines.zh: 拳头打在身上，我懒得躲。
lines.en: A fist lands on me; I cannot be bothered to dodge.
Pain passes. Humiliation does not.

lines.zh: 我站直，不让肩膀塌下去。
lines.en: I straighten up so my shoulders do not sag.
The taste of blood in my mouth is not unpleasant.
This is not enough to bring me down.

lines.zh: 食物？我不需要你的好意。
lines.en: Food? I do not need your kindness.
That smell is passable.
Put it down. I will take it myself.
A Saiyan appetite is larger than this.
I eat fast. Do not stare.

lines.zh: 这种程度的东西，也敢拿来。
lines.en: You dare bring me something like this.
I am not picky about food, only opponents.
When I finish eating I train again.
Princes get hungry. Is that strange?
Bring another portion. I would not object.
The quest building's door, do not crowd it.
Speak quickly, I have no patience.
That is not worth a reaction.
You are blocking my path at the door.
Speak your business. Do not bump into me.
I step aside. This once.

lines.zh: 再撞一下，我就当你挑衅。
lines.en: Bump me again and I take it as a challenge.

lines.zh: 我的护腕不是给人撞的。
lines.en: My bracer is not for people to bump into.

lines.zh: 你比我矮半个头，还敢挤。
lines.en: Half a head shorter and still you crowd me.
You are the one in the way; move.
That woman Bulma never stops shouting.

lines.zh: 她修东西的时候，我在旁边看。
lines.en: When she fixes things I watch from the side.

lines.zh: 我不会说那种好听的话。
lines.en: I do not say pretty things.
She scolds me and I still do not leave.

lines.zh: 家里那台机器是她做的。
lines.en: That machine at home is her work.

lines.zh: 重力室是她修的，我记着。
lines.en: She repaired the gravity chamber. I remember.
My son talks more than I do.

lines.zh: 我护着这个家，只是不说。
lines.en: I guard this family. I simply do not say so.

lines.zh: 她睡着的时候，屋里很静。
lines.en: When she sleeps the house is very quiet.
I do not discuss such things with outsiders.
Whose is this on the floor?
I pick it up and glance at it.
I know this capsule.
This lump of iron is useless.

lines.zh: 我把它放在桌上，没收起来。
lines.en: I set it on the table and do not pocket it.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的东西，我懒得弯腰。
lines.en: I do not bend for things dropped on the floor.
This stone has some weight to it.
I crush the scrap of paper into a ball.

lines.zh: 这玩意儿，丢了也不值钱。
lines.en: This thing is not worth much even if lost.
I push the thing back where it was.

lines.zh: 任务牌上写着你的名字，过来。
lines.en: Your name is on the quest board; come here.

lines.zh: 我看你抬手的样子，有几分架势。
lines.en: The way you raise your arm has some form to it.

lines.zh: 我只是在看你，不是要打。
lines.en: I am only watching you. Not fighting.
You want to start something? Find your footing first.
That killing intent does not hide well.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛一直没离开你，任务说吧。
lines.en: My eyes never left you; state your mission.
His fist is set wrong.

lines.zh: 我不出手，不代表我看不见。
lines.en: Not striking does not mean I cannot see.
If you move first, I may not strike back.
Remember this distance. I can reach it.
I am weighing what you are worth.
Your weight sits on the left.

lines.zh: 这一招我一眼就看穿了。
lines.en: I read that technique at a glance.
You breathe too fast. You will tire first.

lines.zh: 我抱手站着，看你怎么做。
lines.en: Arms folded, I watch what you do.
You have some nerve. I grant you that.
This is not worth raising my hand.
Your footwork slipped half a step.
I am waiting for your first move.
After this you will still be nothing.
I raise my hand, then stop it.

lines.zh: 拳头停在半空，我不打弱者。
lines.en: My fist halts in the air. I do not strike the weak.
I hold back on this punch.
I turn and throw an elbow, only as example.
My leg comes up, then goes back down.
I am only training. Not killing you.

lines.zh: 这一下若真打，你已经倒了。
lines.en: If that landed for real, you would be down.

lines.zh: 我把拳停在离你一寸处。
lines.en: I stop my fist an inch from you.
Watch closely. This is how a punch goes.
I kick the air and recover.

lines.zh: 我从屋里出来，站在门口。
lines.en: I come out of the room and stand in the doorway.
Who arranged this place?

lines.zh: 我落地时没扬起一点尘。
lines.en: I land without raising a speck of dust.

lines.zh: 王子到哪儿，都不需要欢迎。
lines.en: The prince needs no welcome anywhere.
I throw the cape back over my shoulder.
The gravity here is too light.
I stand on the steps and look down.

lines.zh: 门口光线正好，我站这儿。
lines.en: The light in the doorway is just right; I will stand here.
The air inside is too close.
I neither greet nor explain.

lines.zh: 火烧到我的袖子，我拍掉了。
lines.en: Fire caught my sleeve and I swatted it out.

lines.zh: 我从高处掉下，膝盖磕了地。
lines.en: I fell from height and my knee struck ground.

lines.zh: 水灌进来，我一时提不上气。
lines.en: Water floods in and for a moment I cannot gather ki.
The blast wave shoved me backward.
A cold arrow is lodged in my shoulder.

lines.zh: 魔法？我的气还没被压住。
lines.en: Magic? My ki is not suppressed yet.
I tell myself I can fight hungry.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，我咬牙顶住。
lines.en: Lightning struck me and I clenched through it.

lines.zh: 我坠入无边的黑，还在挣扎。
lines.en: I fall into endless black and keep fighting it.
